source_snapshot.procedure: Change the BMC login password from the profile settings page reached through the upper-right user icon.
source_snapshot.criteria: Change the user login password from the profile settings page correctly.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes browser or Redfish AccountService PATCH, but an administrative PATCH is not equivalent to the enrolled user's self-service profile control.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; distinguishes the existing-account profile change from first-login enrollment and requires protected secrets, trusted endpoint, session/audit evidence and recovery.

old_problem: The historical record correctly defined the self-service UI state transition but retained Pending because account ownership, password policy, protected current/new secrets, session behavior, final rotation and recovery were not supplied.
disposition_reason: The interface and intent are explicit: an already-enrolled user changes its own login password through the WebUI profile control. Exact build, owned account, field validation, password/session policy, secret custody, attempt budget and recovery are Project execution inputs. A direct administrator-side AccountService update can support setup/recovery only; it cannot prove profile navigation, current-password validation, UI feedback or self-service session behavior.
decision_basis: XLSX row 843, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.
This is an enrolled-user self-service profile test, independently distinct from the preceding one-time first-login forced-change case.
Project/vendor profile, password, session and recovery specifications are the authority for field requirements and transition behavior; secrets and policy values are not guessed.

ED-08 preserves actual WebUI evidence, ED-15 requires approved acceptance behavior, ED-20 preserves this case's identity, ED-35 rejects API-only substitution, and ED-38 controls credential mutation and recovery.

test_case.test_name: Verify enrolled user self-service password change through BMC Web profile
test_case.purpose: Prove an approved already-enrolled BMC user can navigate from the upper-right user icon to its profile password control, satisfy current/new/confirmation validation, change only its own login secret once, observe the specified UI/session transition, and re-authenticate as the same identity/privilege while old credential and sessions follow Project policy.
required_package: Immutable BMC identity, trusted management URL/certificate, firmware/WebUI/authentication-provider build and supported browser
Owned non-production enrolled account, exact privilege, current active-session inventory and confirmation it is not shared or the sole recovery account
Version-matched profile-page route/control plus current/new/confirmation fields, validation messages and re-authentication behavior
Password length/complexity/history/expiration/reuse policy and protected current/new secret handles with custodian/final rotation owner
Approved old-credential behavior, current/other-session invalidation or continuation, identity/privilege probes and audit-event mapping
Attempt budget below lockout/rate limits, MFA/CAPTCHA/SSO/CSRF behavior, alternate administrator/console/OOB recovery and final restore/rotate/retire state
test_case.test_command: Verify endpoint/build and the authenticated disposable account identity/ownership/privilege, record active-session and audit baselines, and approve password policy, attempt limit, recovery and final credential state. In an isolated supported browser, authenticate through protected input, navigate using the upper-right user icon to the actual profile password control, and capture redacted evidence of that route. Submit the current, generated new and confirmation secrets once through protected fields. Record non-secret validation/success and the specified session transition; then within the attempt budget verify old credential and pre-existing sessions behave exactly as approved and the new credential authenticates the same identity/privilege. Preserve audit events, reconcile/revoke sessions and rotate, restore or retire the account as approved. Do not use an API-only shortcut, clear logs, expose secrets or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The owned enrolled account reaches the correct self-service profile control, required fields and password-policy validation behave as specified, and the single approved change affects only that account. WebUI feedback and session transition match the versioned policy; the old credential and all relevant sessions are accepted or rejected exactly as specified, and the new credential authenticates the same intended identity/privilege. Audit events and final account/session state are complete, no secret is disclosed and independent recovery remains available.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires identity/account binding, real profile navigation from the user icon, required current/new/confirmation validation, one approved self-service change, exact UI/session/audit transition, bounded old-credential/session verification, protected new-password re-login as the same identity/role and verified final rotation/cleanup. An AccountService PATCH, success toast, HTTP status, changed account attribute or first-login workflow cannot substitute. Wrong account, missing current-password gate, unexpected validation, failed/unknown new secret, incorrect privilege, policy-inconsistent session survival, lockout, leaked secret or failed cleanup is FAIL. Missing Project inputs or approval is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Use only an owned disposable/lab account; never alter a shared, production-critical or sole recovery account without exceptional approval and independent recovery.
Validate endpoint certificate/build and authenticated account alias/privilege before opening or submitting the profile form.
Keep current/new/confirmation passwords, cookies, CSRF tokens and recovery credentials out of URLs, commands, screenshots, browser/network traces and records.
Do not submit until active-session impact, password history, attempt budget, secret custodian, recovery and final credential state are approved; submit once with no automatic retry.
Do not promise rollback to the old password because password history may prohibit reuse; use the approved rotation or retirement plan.
Administrative Redfish/AccountService may be used only for separately approved inspection/setup/recovery and cannot satisfy the profile-page checkpoint.
Never clear audit/BMC/system logs; stop on endpoint/account mismatch, unexpected privilege/session effects, policy rejection, access loss or uncertain recovery.
expected_evidence: BMC endpoint/certificate, firmware/WebUI/auth build, supported browser and owned account alias/privilege/active-session baseline
Password-policy, protected secret-custody, attempt-budget, final-rotation and independent-recovery approvals
Redacted navigation evidence from the upper-right user icon to the profile password control and required field/validation states
Single redacted submission result, exact UI feedback/session transition and corresponding timestamped audit/security events
Bounded old-credential/session behavior and protected new-password re-login proving the same identity/privilege
All test sessions reconciled, final account rotation/restore/retirement, recovery-path health and authorized engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If the change targets the wrong account, access is lost, validation is unexpected or session behavior is unsafe, stop immediately and preserve first-failure UI/audit evidence. The authorized owner uses the verified alternate administrator/console/OOB path to revoke sessions and rotate, restore or retire only the disposable account according to password-history policy, then verifies BMC reachability and audit continuity. Do not guess credentials, resubmit or clear logs.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently specify an existing user's BMC Web profile password change. The word `correctly` needs versioned Project acceptance detail but is not a competing requirement.

blocked.reason: The self-service UI operation is clear; owned account, build, password/session policies, protected secrets, recovery and final state are supplyable prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/UI build, owned enrolled account, exact profile validation, password/session/lockout policy, protected secrets, attempt budget, recovery and final rotation state.

project_authority: The version-matched Project/vendor profile password-change, account, session, audit and recovery specifications define correct behavior. Any API-only override must record that profile-UI coverage remains unverified.
